title: Event Monitoring & Notification API Rate Limits

blocks.text: Rate limits throttle the number of API calls you can make. All endpoints within the Event Monitoring & Notification API are subject to a rate limit of 1,000 calls per second, per tenant.
The Event Monitoring & Notification API sends the following rate limit headers in API responses:

blocks.item: x-ratelimit-limit: The rate limit ceiling that is applicable for the current API request.
x-ratelimit-remaining: The number of API requests remaining for the current rate limit window.
x-ratelimit-reset: The time (in Unix epoch seconds) remaining in the current window, after which the rate limit resets.
